propositions: When the completion verifier fails due to exhausted evidence search budget without refuting criteria, the gate should auto-resume verification instead of surfacing failure to the operator.
Auto-resume qualification uses the existing _insufficiency_only predicate to detect failures where all unmet criteria carry the evidence_sufficient:false marker.
Resumptions are bounded by verify.auto_resume_max config (default 2, disabled at 0) and by progress—a resumption dispatches only if the prior attempt strictly increased cache-credited PASS count.
The resumption loop sits at the shared close-gate seam in _completion_precheck, ensuring CLI, MCP, and library closes all exercise the same mechanism.
Per-attempt trail including attempt number, cache-credited count, and remaining criteria is recorded in the verdict and visible in close output.
